INSIDER TIPS

Smart Hacks to Get More Food for Less at Panda Express

Tested ordering secrets to maximize your portion size, flavor variety, and wallet savings:

PORTION HACK
⚖️

Order Half & Half Sides

You can typically request half and half sides (e.g. half Chow Mein and half Super Greens) for split variety. Ask your location, as policies vary by store.

VALUE KING
🍱

Bigger Plate is the Lowest Cost Per Entrée

A Bigger Plate costs only ~$2.00 more than a regular Plate, but adds a 3rd entrée box. Whether splitting or saving leftovers, it delivers the highest food-per-dollar ratio.

SAUCE OPTIONS
🥣

Sauce Requests at Counter

Panda Express offers Sweet & Sour, Hot Mustard, and Soy Sauce packets upon request. Some locations provide side cups of warm Teriyaki glaze; ask your location, as policies vary.
